morphology.pattern_note: 英语单音节整词，w 不发音。输入的“se- or numeral”不是音节划分，不能用作本词的读音资料；也不能把英语 whole 分析成马来语 se- 派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 整个的；全部的；完整、未分开的。
senses.ms_definition: Seluruh, lengkap atau utuh, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 英语词义，不能标作正式马来语词义。下列搭配保留英语形式以展示目标词；正式马来语应使用相应译词。参见 [Cambridge：whole](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/whole?topic=both-all-each-and-every)。

senses.zh_definition: 整体；由所有部分构成的完整事物。
senses.en_definition: A complete entity comprising all its parts.
senses.ms_definition: Keseluruhan atau satu kesatuan yang lengkap.
senses.nuances: as a whole 表示作为整体；on the whole 通常表示总的来说。参见 [Cambridge Essential：whole](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/essential-british-english/whole)。

collocations.zh: 作为一个整体；从整体来看

collocations.ms: the whole of the report — keseluruhan laporan

senses.zh_definition: 整个地；不切开、不分成小块地。
senses.en_definition: In one piece, without being divided.
senses.ms_definition: Secara utuh, tanpa dipotong atau dipecahkan.
senses.nuances: 描述处理某物的方式，不等于一般表示程度的 completely。参见 [Cambridge：whole，副词义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/whole?topic=someone-anyone-no-one-or-everyone)。

messages.ms_spoken: Lama betul! Jom balik je, dah lewat ni.

messages.zh: 也太久了！都这么晚了，咱们回去吧。
messages.en: That's ages! Let's just head home—it's getting late.

etymology.historical_story: English whole descends from Old English hāl, which connected completeness with being healthy or unharmed. Its history helps explain why an intact object and a complete amount share one word. The later spelling acquired a w that is silent today. This is an English history; an occurrence inside Malay conversation should be identified separately as code-switching. [Etymonline: whole](https://www.etymonline.com/word/whole)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 whole 想成“完整的一整块”；开头 w 静音，whole cake 就是一整个蛋糕。
